en.title: Access management
en.name: Name
en.subject: User identity
en.error: The operation failed. Check the form and try again.
en.denied: You do not have permission to manage access.
en.conflict: This record changed. Reload and review before saving.
en.identitySaved: Identity directory saved; local permissions are unchanged.
en.localSaved: Local permissions saved; identity assignments are unchanged.
en.notFound: The requested record was not found.
en.identityUnavailable: The shared identity definition is unavailable.
en.configureLocalFirst: Configure this project's local binding first.
en.directoryStale: The identity directory changed or is unavailable. Reload and review before saving.
en.independentSaves: Identity directory and local permissions are saved separately. Neither save synchronizes the other.
en.completeScopeRule: Each scope must contain its complete resource ranges and actions. Permissions cannot be assembled across scopes.
en.stateDisclaimer: This shows current identity records and local bindings, not permissions already effective in a signed-in session. Client approval, consent and session validation still apply.
en.accountNoGrant: Saving account details does not grant project scopes.
en.metadataRange: METADATA permits only shared tenant metadata READ/LIST within this scope’s identity intent. It grants no management or business resource access.
en.reconciliationRequired: The directory revision changed. Review all bindings before explicitly confirming. Business requests remain denied.
en.reconciliationReview: Review every scope's complete business and management grants against the current directory limits. Confirmation does not edit the shared directory.
en.confirmDirectoryRevision: Confirm reviewed bindings at this revision
en.reconciliationSaved: Local binding confirmation was saved. Authenticate again and verify successful access before resuming business operations.
en.firstPartyUiReceipt: Explicit approval is required. Only the UI client registered by the host installation receipt may use this flag. Names do not prove eligibility; the server validates and may reject it.
en.reauthenticationRequired: The identity directory changed or this session expired. Sign in again through the host before continuing. Reload alone does not restore authority.
en.localRecoveryOnly: After signing in again, only a current trusted LOCAL_POLICY.MANAGE scope may review and confirm complete local bindings. Recovery grants no identity directory, account, client or assignment management. Business access remains denied until confirmation succeeds and reauthentication is verified.
en.atomicReconciliationHelp: Edit and review every scope against the latest read-only shared limits, explicitly enter the current directory revision, then approve one atomic project save. No individual scope save can reconcile a stale project. Identity management remains closed during recovery.
en.reviewDirectoryRevision: Enter the current revision shown by the read-only recovery projection; it is never copied automatically.
en.managementProjectIdsHelp: LOCAL_POLICY only. One exact ID per line; no wildcard, path or duplicate. Empty means this scope's own project. Nonempty means only the listed projects, without implicitly adding the owning project.
en.newLocalBindingHelp: Select an existing shared scope and configure its complete local grants. The binding starts disabled and empty. Saving does not change the identity directory or grant scopes to users.
